content: The listed copies of Sharḥ al-Tajallī al-Dhātī (Arabic; variant titles Sharḥ Risālat al-Tajallī al-Dhātī, Sharḥ Kalimāt Ibn Hūd, Taṣḥīḥ Kalām Ibn Hūd al-Maghribī) are MS Princeton 2002/5 ff. 60a-62a (1093/1682 (?)), MS Nūrbakhsh 868/6 (11th/17th century), MS Sipahsālār 2930/7 (undated) and MS Mishkāt 1033/5 (undated); none is in MS Majlis 10196.
